app.label: Interface scale
app.description: Enlarges menus and text for readability. Some screens may not fit larger sizes perfectly yet.

app.label: Density
app.description: How much breathing room to leave around controls and lists.

app.label: Show advanced settings
app.description: Reveals settings most people won't need, including raw core options.

app.label: Show the welcome flow
app.description: Shows first-run setup again the next time Firelight starts.

app.label: Turn keyboard hotkeys off automatically
app.description: When a system wants the keyboard to itself, stop keyboard hotkeys firing while it runs. Controller hotkeys keep working.
app._note: The core says so itself via RETRO_ENVIRONMENT_SET_KEYBOARD_CALLBACK, which is what makes this possible without anyone predicting which cores need it.

app.label: Only player one can use hotkeys
app.description: Stops other players saving, exiting or changing speed. The keyboard counts as whichever player it holds.

app.label: Preferred regions
app.description: Which release a grouped game shows first, best to worst.

app.label: Preferred languages
app.description: Breaks a tie between grouped releases from the same region.
